resource_decisions.required: 补真实多provider observer/并发换页pin的peak/live/reserved、持有时长/byte-time和同硬限额成功集合；端点退款不是全部压力裁决。

exit_sequence.output: Current candidate identity/evidence packaging and six finite consumer closures; 33 original rows map entry, authority, acceptance, refusal/retry and final release; migrated or retained with actual contract. No unexplained stale anchor/temporary bridge.

Six bounded resource receipts at actual endpoints; real allocations, live/reserved/peak, residence, progress and same hard-limit public success/refusal. Reuse existing tests, add missing witnesses only. Cold-layout geometry and history-to-queue timing are first priorities.

Freeze unchanged output/work/control scope, before-package/current/upstream identities, endpoint and pricing plan. Attribute actual event counts, added/transferred work and final drain. Numerical unknowns remain explicit; use only predeclared bounded diagnostics where needed, not RF20 results as its own prerequisite.

After original readiness gate passes, run full mechanism/resource and uninstrumented package comparison; then separately judge cost targets, equivalent upstream and M6. No arbitrary 30% gate or assumed positive payoff.

stop_rules: No new broad optimization merely because unit price is unknown.
Repair only a concrete contract failure or unmigrated consumer found by bounded validation.
Space increase alone is not rejection when time-first priority and hard-limit/public contracts hold.
Cold-layout standalone refusal is a real warning, not yet a public-pipeline success-set verdict.
Full matrix does not require exhaustive combinations; cover distinct failure/lifetime/pressure boundaries and actual entry families.
No performance, management ratio, paid<1M or M6 qualification is inferred from code/test counts.
